display.purpose: Editorial headlines only — section headings, verdicts, masthead. Never on tool surfaces.

headline.purpose: Terminal/product hero titles on dark canvases, page titles.

body.purpose: Prose and UI text; 65–75ch cap on editorial, drops to 14px in dense UI.

mono.purpose: Every financial value: prices, %, tickers, timestamps. Always tabular.

shadows.name: resting-hairline

shadows.name: strong-lift

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--color-text-primary, #1c1917); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-jakarta, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2a2723; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Fully-round filter toggle for screener presets and category filters. Active inverts to Signal Blue.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e7e5e4); background: var(--color-bg-card, #ffffff); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #78716c); font-family: var(--font-jakarta, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); color: var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); } .ds-pill-active { background: var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); color: #ffffff; border-color: var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); } .ds-pill-active:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Indicator Card
components.description: Flat-at-rest data card. Mono micro-label, tabular mono value, directional delta with arrow. Lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; background: var(--color-bg-card, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 12px; transition: box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 250ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-tertiary, #928b85); } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1c1917); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-delta { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-bullish, #0d9488); }

PASAR HARI INI

components.css: .ds-sh { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; } .ds-sh-rule { width: 4px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #0ea5e9); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-sh-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 2px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-tertiary, #928b85); } .ds-sh-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-newsreader, Georgia, serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--color-text-primary, #1c1917); }

components.css: .ds-verdict { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 20px 16px; background: var(--color-bg-card, #ffffff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e7e5e4); } .ds-verdict-rule { width: 6px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-bullish, #0d9488); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-verdict-kicker { margin: 0 0 2px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-tertiary, #928b85); } .ds-verdict-label { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-newsreader, Georgia, serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--color-bullish, #0d9488); } .ds-verdict-summary { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-jakarta, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #78716c); }

components.css: .ds-ticker { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; background: #0f172a; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(13,148,136,0.15); } .ds-ticker-track { display: inline-flex; animation: ds-ticker 60s linear infinite; } .ds-ticker:hover .ds-ticker-track { animation-play-state: paused; } .ds-ticker-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ticker-item b { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-up { color: #2dd4bf; font-style: normal; } .ds-down { color: #f87171; font-style: normal; } @keyframes ds-ticker { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ticker-track { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
TeknikalID is a calm, professional workspace where dense terminal data meets broadsheet readability. The analyst sits at a desk, not in a casino: numbers are exact and tabular, direction is encoded in color, and every pixel of decoration has to justify itself against the data it surrounds. Authority comes from clarity, never from loudness.

The system runs in two registers that share one desk. Terminal mode — dark slate canvases, a live mono ticker tape, crosshatch grids, radial glows, Geist Mono numerics — carries the markets when the data is live. Broadsheet mode — Newsreader serif headlines on a cool near-white, generous measure, leading accent rules — carries the editorial publication and the human-language verdicts that lead every stock page.
keyCharacteristics: Cool near-white paper (#f8fafc) with warm-stone ink (#1c1917); one sky-blue brand accent (#0ea5e9) used sparingly.
Direction-as-meaning: teal (#0d9488) bullish / red (#dc2626) bearish, always paired with a non-color signal.
Three typefaces with strict jobs: Plus Jakarta Sans (UI), Geist Mono (all financial values), Newsreader (editorial headlines only).
Flat-at-rest surfaces that lift on state via soft, layered shadows; reduced-motion always respected.
Compact, dense controls (32px default) — a tool, not a brochure.

rules.name: The Direction-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Teal and red encode data direction only. Never use them as a generic accent or decorative gradient stop.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only brand accent — focus, active state, the single leading rule, links. Used on ≤10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every financial value is Geist Mono with tabular figures. A price in the proportional sans is a bug.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card at rest has no drop shadow — only a hairline or tonal step. Shadow is a response to state.

rules.name: The No-Border-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Directional color via background tint, leading rule, icon, or full border — never a border-left/right stripe thicker than 1px.

dos: Do set every financial value in Geist Mono with tabular-nums.
Do pair every bullish/bearish color with a non-color signal (icon, arrow, word).
Do lead stock pages with a plain-language SignalVerdict in Bahasa Indonesia.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and reserve shadow for hover, focus, and genuine elevation.
Do use Newsreader only for editorial headlines and verdicts; Jakarta for tool/UI surfaces.
Do verify Ink-Muted contrast and bump toward Ink where it falls below 4.5:1.
donts: Don't use border-left/right thicker than 1px as a colored stripe — legacy .trade-card-bullish / .holding-card-* / .comparison-* / .tip-box / .warning-box / .akademi-featured stripes are debt to retire.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text) anywhere — admin .admin-gradient-text is debt.
Don't build crypto / gambling-bro hype: no neon gradients, moon/rocket iconography, or get-rich-quick energy.
Don't default to generic SaaS-fintech: no cream/beige paper, identical icon-card grids, or the hero-metric template.
Don't ship cluttered legacy-broker density — low-contrast tables crammed together.
Don't copy NYSE/Nasdaq conventions wholesale — this is an IDX product for an Indonesian audience.
Don't add a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section — the mono micro-kicker is a reserved system.
Don't put a resting drop shadow on a non-elevated card, or animate layout properties when transform/opacity will do.
